{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, removing commas and coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')

# Filter out QA rows (revenue == 999999.99) and refunded orders
real_completed = sales[(sales['revenue'] != 999999.99) & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue of real completed orders
mean_revenue = real_completed['revenue'].mean()

mean_revenue"}
